channel.title: LiVEUO — pharCare pharmacy software guides
channel.description: Daily guides on pharmacy billing, GST compliance, and inventory control for Indian pharmacies.

item.title: Multi-branch pharmacy billing: what to look for in software
item.description: Running three pharmacies is not running one pharmacy three times. What changes in stock visibility, transfers, pricing control, permissions and reporting.

item.title: Switching from Marg ERP to pharCare: a migration checklist
item.description: What to export, what to clean, what to reconcile, and how to run a parallel week — a step-by-step checklist for moving a pharmacy off Marg ERP safely.

item.title: How to reduce expired-stock write-offs in a retail pharmacy
item.description: Expired stock is pure margin loss and most of it is preventable. Batch discipline, near-expiry alerts, supplier return windows, and the buying that causes it.

item.title: GST invoicing for pharmacies: a practical guide
item.description: Multiple tax slabs on one bill, batch-level MRP, credit notes for expiry returns, and GSTR-ready exports. A working guide to GST invoicing in an Indian retail pharmacy.

item.title: Schedule H, H1 and H1X: what pharmacy software must track
item.description: Schedule H, H1 and H1X carry different record-keeping duties. Exactly what your pharmacy billing software must capture at the counter, and for how long.
